input.new_string:
"""Browser authentication-state boundary."""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
import hmac
import time

COOKIE_NAME = "auth_state"
DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_SECONDS = 60 * 60 * 24 * 14  # 14 days


def _sign(payload: str, secret: str) -> str:
    digest = hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), payload.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).digest()
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(digest).rstrip(b"=").decode("ascii")


def create_browser_auth_state(user_id: str, secret: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    issued_at = int(time.time())
    payload = f"{user_id}.{issued_at}"
    signed_value = f"{payload}.{_sign(payload, secret)}"

    return {
        "name": COOKIE_NAME,
        "value": signed_value,
        "http_only": True,
        "secure": True,
        "same_site": "Strict",
        "max_age": DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_SECONDS,
    }
